title: Flaky end-to-end test on the cart page
description: The cart page end-to-end test failed about one run in ten with no code change.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: Root cause: the test clicked the quantity button while the page animation was still running, so the click sometimes missed.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: Fixed by waiting until the cart request finishes and the animation ends before clicking.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: We rejected retrying the test three times because it would hide real race conditions in the product.
